about_the_game:
Join among the beverage Kings of old America!

Fizz Flow is a strategy and management game that takes place in a setting without competition regulations. In old America, where the beverage industry is on the rise, embark on an adventure to make a name for yourself. Build your own factory!  Make your own unique recipes! Weaken your opponents and maintain your place at the market!

Optimise your factory!

Optimize production by managing your workers, managers, raw material supply, and machines. Please your customers and preserve your relations.

 

Think like a real boss!

A shrewd businessman who turns crises into advantage? A visionary boss who ignores details and dreams big? Live in the moment or invest in the future!

 

Capture the networks, capture the market!

Big business doesn't work well with production alone! Disrupt your competitors' customer network, attract suppliers to your side and leave your competitors without raw materials!

 

Rivalry all the way!

Win new customers, get big contracts and try to fulfill orders. You don't have to play fair... Send spies to rival factories, disrupt their business, sabotage their machines, take them over!

 

Merchant? King of the Black Market?

Do you want to grow your income honestly or become a real power in the shadows? Every decision will have consequences.

 

Take over the Industry

Make your own recipes and produce the products demanded in the market! Capture the market and become the leader of the industry. Crown your production adventure that started in a small workshop, with a giant factory with the latest technology!

Plan, Improve, Grow

  • Build your factory and design it to the most efficiency.

  • Buy new machines, modify them and increase your productive power and conduct research to increase your production power.

  • Set up new production lines for the ever-changing market.

  • Get ahead of the market by being the first to research new types of drinks.

  • Manage your workers and managers, and outshine your competitors with the best teams.

  • Spy on, sabotage, take over your competitors.

  • Take over and disrupt your competitors' customer networks and control the market.

Easy Gameplay, Never Without Strategy

Want to set things right at the factory over a hot cup of coffee? This game is cozy but the competition is fierce! Manage time, resources, production and workers, satisfy your customers, destroy your competitors and maintain your hard earned success at the market!

name: Fizz Flow: Factory Management

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4330 (2 * 3500); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 (2048 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500(4 * 3800); AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 * 3100)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2048 VRAM); Radeon R9 380 (2048 VRAM)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
